estimates.assumptions: 1.5 kg raw potatoes, peeled and boiled (edible portion only); ~12 g carbs and 1.5 g fiber per 100 g
30 g butter, fully used in potato topping
5 tbsp (75 ml) double cream, fully used in potato topping
2 large egg yolks, fully used in potato topping
30 g butter, fully used in vegetable base
7 medium shallots (~175 g total), peeled and used in filling; ~11.5 g carbs and 2.3 g fiber per 100 g
3 medium carrots chopped (~300 g total), used in filling; ~7 g carbs and 2 g fiber per 100 g
2 celery sticks (~80 g total), used in filling; ~3 g carbs and 2 g fiber per 100 g
1 garlic clove (~5 g), finely chopped and used in filling
4 tbsp (60 ml) white wine, alcohol mostly evaporates but sugars retained
1 tbsp (15 g) tomato puree, used in filling
400 g tinned tomatoes (whole can including juice), used in filling
350 ml chicken stock, typical commercial values
600 g cooked shredded chicken (edible meat only, skinless assumed)
16 medium black olives (~80 g total, pitted), used in filling
2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley (~8 g), modest quantity used in filling
50 g Gruyere cheese, grated for topping
